caption: The drawing features a symmetrical composition with a rounded top and straight sides and bottom, outlined in red. Inside the composition, there are four stylized birds with blue bodies, red wings decorated with pink spots, and black tail feathers. Two birds are positioned at the top, facing inward toward the center, and two are at the bottom, facing each other. The background is a light grayish color. Between and around the birds, various flowers are arranged on winding black stems. The flowers are colored in combinations of yellow, blue, red, and pink, with petal shapes that include pointed, rounded, and tulip-like forms. At the center top and bottom, larger flowers display multiple layers of petals. The base of the composition shows a yellow, undulating band with red, blue, and green spots. The entire design is neatly enclosed by the red border, and the drawing has a plain beige background.
title: Study for Proposed Portfolio "Decorated Chests of Rural Pennsylvania"
